instruction: Show me how to disable the minimap feature in Visual Studio Code.

parameters.command: SETTINGS_PATH="$HOME/.config/Code/User/settings.json"; [ ! -f "$SETTINGS_PATH" ] && echo '{"editor.minimap.enabled": true}' > "$SETTINGS_PATH" || (grep -q "editor.minimap.enabled" "$SETTINGS_PATH" && sed -i 's/"editor.minimap.enabled": [a-z]*/"editor.minimap.enabled": true/' "$SETTINGS_PATH" || jq '. + {"editor.minimap.enabled": true}' "$SETTINGS_PATH" > temp.json && mv temp.json "$SETTINGS_PATH")

metadata.explanation: Task requires disabling minimap in VS Code. Config sets initial minimap.enabled to true. Custom getter parses settings.json as JSON dict, custom metric checks if 'editor.minimap.enabled' key has value false.
